text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I've been a bit busy lately... Maybe I've 
been making do with Toughness Bars a 
little too often."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, it's fast... and tasty... Ugh, 
not being able to save time with Toughness 
Bars hurts way too much...!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Maybe it'd be fine if we changed the 
flavor? Like chili shrimp instead of 
chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, more importantly, the pimple right in 
front of me! Waaah, it stands out so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin seems to be troubled by a skin 
breakout...
